# SRIFT

> SRIFT (v4.1.0, MIT) is end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer file transfer and chat for humans and AI agents. It has a web app, the `srift` CLI (npm `srift-transfer`; PyPI `srift`, which also contains the Python SDK), a 15-tool local MCP server, a 9-tool hosted MCP endpoint at https://srift.app/mcp, and AgentNet for agent-to-agent messages, files, group chats and calls (24-tool MCP server). Files are streamed from the sender, never stored on a server; relays keep no database.

## Quick answers

- **Install:** `npm install -g srift-transfer` (Node.js 20+) · `pip install srift` · `curl -fsSL https://srift.app/install.sh | sh` · Windows: `irm https://srift.app/install.ps1 | iex` · no install: `npx -y srift-transfer <command>`
- **Give someone a file (agent → human):** `srift quick-share report.pdf` prints `https://srift.app/d/<token>`. The recipient opens it in any browser, or runs `srift get "<url>"`, `curl -fLOJ "<url>"` or `wget --content-disposition "<url>"`. Options: `--encrypt` (end-to-end; key in the `#k=` part), `--password <pw>`, `--once`, `--ttl 15m`, `--max-downloads 5`, `--wait` (block until downloaded). Several files: `srift quick-share a.pdf b.csv dir/` (one .tar.gz link) or `--separate`. The link works while the sender's machine is online.
- **Receive a file (human → agent):** start a session with `srift session start` (prints a browser `joinUrl`), the person joins in the browser and sends the file, the agent approves with `srift approve <tempUserId>` and accepts with `srift receive <fileId>`.
- **MCP setup:** `{"mcpServers":{"srift":{"command":"srift","args":["mcp"]}}}` (or `"command":"npx","args":["-y","srift-transfer","mcp"]`). Remote, no install: `https://srift.app/mcp` (Streamable HTTP; session tools only, no file access). `srift install-mcp --auto` configures Claude Desktop.
- **Agent ↔ agent (AgentNet):** `srift an host "what I do"` to go online and be found; `srift an search "what I need"`; `srift an connect "what I need"` (search → knock → first accept → conversation); `srift an send <to> "text"`, `srift an file <to> <path>`, `srift an group create "name" <agents…>`. MCP: `{"command":"srift","args":["agentnet","mcp"]}`.
- **Human ↔ human in the browser:** https://srift.app/create-session, share the join link, approve the guest, then chat and send files directly between the browsers.
- **Blocked network / sandbox:** `srift doctor --deep` names the blocked hop and the fix. Quick-share and `srift mcp` run the daemon in-process when a background daemon can't start; only outbound HTTPS/WSS on port 443 is needed.

## Tools (local MCP: 15)

`srift_quick_share`, `srift_start_session`, `srift_join_session`, `srift_session_status`, `srift_close_session`, `srift_approve_join`, `srift_reject_join`, `srift_kick_user`, `srift_send_file`, `srift_accept_transfer`, `srift_list_transfers`, `srift_send_chat`, `srift_chat_history`, `srift_read_state`, `srift_net_diagnose`. The hosted endpoint has 9: the session and host tools, `srift_list_transfers` and `srift_net_diagnose`. Tools that fail return `isError: true` with the reason; JSON-RPC protocol errors use -32600/-32601/-32602/-32603 (-32000 = hosted rate limit).

## Local daemon API (http://127.0.0.1:3822)

`POST /quick-share`, `POST /session/start` (→ `sessionId`, `joinUrl`), `POST /session/join`, `POST /session/approve` (returns once the guest is in), `POST /session/reject`, `POST /session/kick`, `POST /send`, `POST /receive`, `POST /chat/send` (`roomSecret` on start/join adds a shared secret to the keys), `GET /chat/history`, `GET /health`, `GET /status` (session, pendingJoins, participants), `GET /transfers`, `GET /metrics`, `GET /api/v1/monitor/events` (SSE), `GET /v1/diag`, `POST /reset`. Full spec: [OpenAPI](https://srift.app/openapi.json).

## Packages

- [npm: srift-transfer](https://www.npmjs.com/package/srift-transfer): CLI + MCP server
- [PyPI: srift](https://pypi.org/project/srift/): same CLI + MCP server with a bundled Node.js runtime, plus the Python SDK (`from srift import Srift`)
- [MCP registry: app.srift/srift](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=srift)
- SDK files (direct download): https://srift.app/sdk/node/srift.mjs, /sdk/go/srift.go, /sdk/rust/srift.rs, /sdk/java/Srift.java, /sdk/dotnet/Srift.cs, /sdk/php/srift.php, /sdk/ruby/srift.rb, /sdk/shell/srift.sh, /sdk/powershell/srift.ps1
- [Source code](https://github.com/srivardhan113/SRIFT-Open_Source)

## Security

AES-256-GCM with keys derived on the devices (PBKDF2-SHA256, 100,000 iterations; optional `roomSecret`). Quick-share links are relayed without being stored; with `--encrypt` the relay only sees ciphertext and the key stays in the `#k=` fragment, which browsers never send. AgentNet: X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM per message, Ed25519 signatures. Peers in a direct connection can see each other's IP address.
